title: 我亲爱的克莱明汀
creator: John Ford
note: 福特把 OK 牧场枪战拍成纪念碑谷下的田园诗，亨利·方达的怀特·厄普克制而悲悯，法律与乡愁各占一半。
noteEn: Ford turns the O.K. Corral into a pastoral under Monument Valley; Henry Fonda's Wyatt Earp balances law and longing.

title: 红河谷
creator: Howard Hawks
note: 一场横贯中西部的超长途牛群迁徙，韦恩与克利夫特的养父子冲突把「文明 vs 蛮荒」的张力拉满。
noteEn: A monumental cattle drive across the Midwest, powered by the surrogate father-son clash between Wayne and Clift.

title: 赤胆屠龙
creator: Howard Hawks
note: 霍克斯写给《正午》的反题：不靠孤独英雄，而靠醉汉、老人与新手各司其职，一起守一座监狱。
noteEn: Hawks' answer to High Noon: no lone hero, just a drunk, an old man and a kid holding one jail together.

title: 双虎屠龙
en: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
creator: John Ford
note: 「当传说成为事实，就印传说。」福特用近乎舞台化的黑白影像清算西部神话与历史的裂缝。
noteEn: When the legend becomes fact, print the legend — Ford's stark black-and-white reckoning with myth versus history.

title: 日落黄沙
creator: Sam Peckinpah
note: 把慢镜头枪战拍成血腥芭蕾，墨西哥革命背景下的末日西部，一举重写银幕暴力美学。
noteEn: Slow-motion gunfire as blood ballet; an apocalyptic western set against the Mexican Revolution that rewrote screen violence.

title: 花村
creator: Robert Altman
note: 阿尔特曼的反神话西部：淘金小镇从泥泞里长出市井百态，配乐竟是莱昂纳德·科恩的民谣。
noteEn: Altman's anti-mythic western — a frontier town built from mud and greed, scored by Leonard Cohen's folk.

title: 墓碑镇
creator: George P. Cosmatos
note: 90 年代最爽快的枪手群像，瓦尔·基默的「医生」霍利迪把每句对白都嚼出了烟与酒的味道。
noteEn: The swaggering gunman ensemble of the '90s; Val Kilmer's Doc Holliday chews every line like tobacco and gin.

title: 神枪手之死
en: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
creator: Andrew Dominik
note: 罗杰·迪金斯镜头下的黄昏蓝调，把英雄的陨落与懦夫的成名写成互为镜像的悲剧。
noteEn: Roger Deakins' twilight-blue study of how a hero's fall and a coward's fame mirror each other.
